scope: Development-only point checks and mechanical share-unit reconstruction; not a certified historical vendor identity, execution price or return backtest
candidate_binding: Exact original filing ticker equals a stock symbol in the frozen USD catalogue; no punctuation aliases, names or current identifier lookup
reference: Original SPY N-PORT USD fair value divided by positive share balance, only long common equity, NS units, level 1 and an exact available historical CUSIP/ticker observation
reference_date: Exact N-PORT portfolio date; no previous-session substitution or interpolation
split_inversion: Multiply provider close by the product of declared split ratios with reference_date < event_date <= frozen_price_cut
origin_share_unit_history: Multiply all trailing provider close and adj_close levels by the same product of declared split ratios after origin and through frozen_price_cut; preserve every return ratio and omit future history
non_share_actions: A future provider price adjustment blocks a point-price reconstruction; any classified non-share adjustment in the selected history blocks the training bundle
known_limitations: N-PORT fair value per share is not a certified exchange closing print
Provider split classifications are hypotheses until issuer events are reconciled
A compatible point does not establish continuous ticker validity or completeness of corporate actions
The frozen current catalogue omits historical instruments and introduces selection and survivorship bias
No broker execution, dividend cash ledger, prices or source availability are certified by this audit
